title: Signature Central-directory listing — Compressed Archive Inspector
description: Signature original — ZIPs store a central directory: names, sizes, and offsets without the file data. Reading it lists members without decompressing anything. Directory-first inspection is fast and safe. This record documents a Signature-authored original method of the JAH archive toolkit, clearly labeled as Signature work rather than a public record.
demo:
# Archive inspection: build a zip in memory, list its central directory WITHOUT extracting.
import io, zipfile
buf = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name, data in {'a.txt': 'hello', 'b.txt': 'world'*100}.items():
        z.writestr(name, data)
buf.seek(0)
with zipfile.ZipFile(buf) as z:
    print("members (inspected, not extracted):")
    for info in z.infolist():
        print(f"  {info.filename:24} {info.file_size:>6} bytes -> {info.compress_size:>6} compressed  crc={info.CRC:08x}")
    if "a.txt" in z.namelist():
        print("peek at %s: %r" % ("a.txt", z.read("a.txt")[:40]))
provenance: Signature-authored original method created for the JAH archive toolkit; clearly labeled Signature, not a public record.
